meta.title: Chat with a coding agent: proposed

frontend.label: UI step where the work started

nodes.label: Chat or Alt+Ctrl+C
nodes.explanation: Chat on the bar, Alt+Ctrl+C on the page, or an element pick or a drawing opens docked chat compact with focus in the composer; pressed while chat is docked, either focuses the composer, and Escape there returns focus to the element that had it (KEY-2, KEY-6, KEY-8). Chat sits at the toolbar's edge beside the notice stack, never over it, in SURF-5's edge order, and an open toolbar panel paints above it (SURF-1, SURF-5, CC-1; chat-compose-04 is toolbar-shell's). In every chat state and at every acceptance viewport the header, the composer row with Send and the mode control, and a pending decision card stay in the viewport: a moved or expanded panel sizes itself to the room it has or moves up until the composer fits, and only the transcript scrolls (SURF-6, SURF-9; chat-compose-02). The header names the conversation by its title with its agent and state word, or 'New conversation', then the conversation list, New Conversation, Expand Chat, Move Chat Panel and Close, which stops nothing (SEL-8, WORD-2, WORD-6). Whether chat was open, its side, the conversation, agent, model and draft come back per stack and page origin, never per checkout (SEL-11, CC-9).

sources.label: Reuses: Chat button on the bar
Replaces: moved expanded panel keeps full height
Replaces: clamp keeps only the header in view

nodes.label: Images and page context
nodes.explanation: Attach Image, a paperclip in the composer apart from New Conversation, and pasting add PNG and JPEG images, each an uncropped thumbnail with its name and size ('screenshot.png · 1.2 MiB'), removable from the keyboard, while the composer counts 'Message 5.8 MiB of 8 MiB' (WORD-5, WORD-8; chat-compose-03, chat-conversations-04). An image that would pass the limit is refused when pasted, naming itself, its size and the limit, never blaming a snapshot (FAIL-2). Page context sits under the composer item by item: each mark's number, element and source file, a gone mark flagged with Select Again and Remove (REV-6, SEL-9, SURF-12); page-context owns that list (page-context-07) and restores marks after a reload (journey-agent-fix-04). It tells the agent the page's URL, service and checkout (SEL-3), and focus returns to the composer after a pick (KEY-12). The unsent text stays in browser storage, and images and page context in the control server's draft record per stack, page origin and conversation, so a reload devhost causes keeps them (UNDO-2, CC-19, Backend 14).

sources.label: Replaces: any image size accepted on paste
Replaces: 8 MiB check at Send blames a snapshot
Replaces: one + for attaching and for new chat

nodes.label: Agent catalog, cached
nodes.explanation: GET /__devhost__/chat/harnesses answers from a catalog cached per stack and checkout, so page loads, tabs and hot reloads start no agent CLI: the page reads it when chat first opens, and Refresh Agents (POST /__devhost__/chat/harnesses/refresh, through the control guard) discovers again, concurrent requests joined to one discovery per agent. It refuses with 403 a request whose Sec-Fetch-Site is cross-site or same-site or whose Origin names another host, and applies the stack's Host rule, as the config routes do for reads (Backend 13; network-exposure-02). Which clients reach the route at all is the network-exposure-01 stopgap's loopback rule, which names this route too; whether a serve session's chat is on is serve-folder's (serve-folder-04). The catalog also publishes whether each agent asks before commands and edits, as its own configuration says, or that devhost could not read it, for the composer's approval line ([discuss] Backend 5, O13).

sources.label: Replaces: both CLIs started on every GET
Replaces: guard skips requests that read

nodes.label: Recipient and edit mode
nodes.explanation: The composer row names who answers and how before Send (SEL-8, REV-6). The chip 'Claude Code · Haiku 4.5' opens Chat Settings as a popover anchored to it, with Agent and Model comboboxes whose options carry each model's description, the first naming what 'Configured default' resolves to (SURF-2, KEY-10; chat-compose-01). The recipient line reads 'To: Fix the nav header · Claude Code · Haiku 4.5'; a conversation's agent is fixed, so choosing another says 'Send starts a new conversation with Codex' before Send (chat-conversations-08). The mode control reads 'This checkout (live) · fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav', with New worktree (review before merge) and Make tickets, each with its effect (O1, SEL-4, WORD-10): live by default with page context, else the conversation's last mode (O3). 'Added by devhost' shows the mode's text, then the team's prompt (O35, CC-10), so nothing is appended out of sight (journey-agent-fix-01, chat-approvals-06: their stopgap ships first). The approval line says whether the agent asks first, in a warning style when it never does (O13; chat-checkout-switch-04).

sources.label: Replaces: Configured default with no description
Replaces: panel names no agent or workflow
Reuses: first installed agent on a first visit

nodes.label: Question before Send
nodes.explanation: A Send never asks except in two cases, each in place above the composer, the draft kept in the composer and nothing shown as working (REV-6, REV-4, SURF-2). A second agent: when a message in This checkout (live) would start this conversation's agent where an agent chat did not start works or waits, 'Start a second agent in fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav? Claude Code, which chat did not start, is working there, and both would edit the same files.' with Cancel focused, which Enter takes, and Start Second Agent (REV-3, CC-14). Cancel or Escape leaves 'Not sent', never an error, and returns focus to the composer; it asks when the conversation's agent would start, never again for its follow-ups, and in the other two modes the recipient line names that agent and Send sends (chat-approvals-04). A gone mark: 'Send with #2 missing? Its element is no longer on this page.' with Select Again focused and Send Anyway (SEL-9).

sources.label: Replaces: agent ID, no risk, Start Anyway first
Replaces: Cancel shown as a red send error
Reuses: asks only about agents it did not start

nodes.label: send with its mode
nodes.explanation: For a new conversation, POST /__devhost__/chat/sessions starts the chosen agent and model in the page's checkout; the browser never names a directory (CC-38). send over /__devhost__/ws/chat carries mode (live, worktree or tickets), required; the server appends the mode's instructions, then [devtools.chat].prompt, and journals record frames for the mode, page context, added text and delivery beside the native events (Backend 1, Backend 2, CC-10, CC-40, UNDO-8). The message shows at once with 'Not sent yet', then 'Mode: This checkout (live) · fix-nav' with 'Added by devhost' collapsed (STATE-1, WORD-10); no acknowledgement in 45 s reads Delivery unconfirmed and is never resent (FB-5, REV-12). Every chat agent starts with AGENT=1 and DEVHOST_CHAT_SESSION, so a devhost command it runs gets agent output and is reported as the agent's (Backend 12, CC-13; agent-cli-journey-06). The Disable Reloads request arrives here in live mode and starts a new conversation unless its popover names an open one (O27, REV-5); its result is reload-control's (reload-and-agents-02).

sources.label: Replaces: one prompt appended to every message
Replaces: default worktree, commit, merge main
Replaces: agent environment without AGENT=1

nodes.label: Follow the turn
nodes.explanation: The reply streams into the transcript, aria-busy and never a live region; tool calls read 'Edited src/header.tsx' and 'Ran bun test · exit code 0' (FB-9, WORD-4). A status line names the turn, 'Claude Code is working · 12 s · 3 tool calls', with Stop Turn in a place Send never takes (FB-1, KEY-11). A follow-up says before Send 'Joins the running turn; the agent reads it at its next step', shows at once with 'Not sent yet' and Take Back while it waits on this page, then 'Sent into the running turn · the agent reads it at its next step'; after that only Stop Turn cancels it (REV-6, STATE-1, UNDO-4; chat-compose-2-02). A turn the agent starts by itself reads 'The agent continued on its own', and compact chat keeps the reply to the person's message with '1 more reply from the agent' (chat-conversations-06); a skill the CLI loaded is one collapsed 'Skill loaded: programming' line, never the person's message (WORD-10; journey-agent-fix-05). Chat on the bar shows the working spinner, named 'Chat: Claude Code working' (SURF-8).

sources.label: Replaces: follow-up hidden until the agent reads
Replaces: queued line that names no message
Replaces: every user frame shown as yours

nodes.label: Waiting look and notice
nodes.explanation: An agent waiting for the person is a condition (ACT-7). Chat takes the waiting look, a shape distinct from the working spinner in both themes and in forced colors, never told by color alone, named 'Chat: Claude Code waiting for you' (ACT-13, SURF-8); the collapsed badge shows it in ACT-7's order; and the notice stack shows 'Claude Code waits for you: Edit src/header.tsx? · Fix the nav header' with Answer, which opens docked chat with focus on the card's question in one activation, kept in its one-line form beside the collapsed badge (FB-8, REV-9; chat-approvals-03). The running agents trigger and Watch Live Activity show the same wait (running-agents). The wait is announced once when it starts and once when it clears, on an answer, a cancel or the turn's end, from any tab (FB-9); while the Configuration window is open, it is announced from inside the window (SURF-4).

sources.label: Replaces: one spinner for working and waiting
Replaces: waiting folded into one busy flag

nodes.label: Decision card, pinned
nodes.explanation: A request is a card pinned between the conversation and the composer, outside any scroll area, every answer in view without scrolling in compact chat at every acceptance viewport (SURF-6, REV-9; chat-approvals-01, with its duplicates chat-compose-2-01 and journey-agent-fix-02). It leads with 'Edit src/header.tsx?', then a checkout-relative path and a unified diff in a capped region, or the exact command, its folder and the agent's reason ('Run bun test? In web/ · to check the header renders'), then 'Note for Claude Code (optional)', Deny, Allow Once and Stop Turn, the native request under Details (Backend 4; chat-approvals-02). A question shows its options and Submit Answers the same way. No answer is a default: an arriving card takes no focus and is announced once (KEY-6, FB-9); it is one Tab stop entered on its question, the arrows move between Details, the note, Deny, Allow Once and Stop Turn, Enter in the note denies and Escape there returns to the question (KEY-8, KEY-9, KEY-10). Several read '1 of 2 requests'. No standing approvals (O12).

sources.label: Replaces: requests in a 40% box over the history
Replaces: raw JSON first, then the buttons
Replaces: bare 'Allow <tool>' title

nodes.label: respond with the answer
nodes.explanation: respond answers one request once; an answer from a second tab to a request already answered or cancelled is refused with the current state, 'Already answered in another tab: You allowed once: Run bun test · 13:24', and nothing is sent twice (REV-12, REV-13). Deny carries the note: Claude Code receives it as the denial's message; Codex, whose answers carry no text, gets the decline and then the note as a message into the running turn, shown as the person's message with its delivery state and without devhost's instructions; an empty note denies with no message, and devhost never sends 'Denied by the user.' (Backend 3, CC-16; chat-approvals-07). Each answer leaves a line where it was given, 'You denied: Edit src/header.tsx · 13:23 · Use the existing NavLink', journaled as an answer record and shown after every reload; a denied call reads Denied in the neutral style, never with the success check (UNDO-8, WORD-7, CC-40; chat-approvals-05). devhost still answers and pre-approves nothing itself (owner rule).

sources.label: Replaces: Deny always sends a fixed text
Replaces: denied call kept as a done call
Reuses: Deny and Allow Once answer once

nodes.label: You stopped this turn
nodes.explanation: Stop Turn in the status line or on a decision card, or Alt+Ctrl+. in the composer and docked chat, ends the turn within a second through the CLI's own interrupt; Escape never does (KEY-8, KEY-9). While a card waits, the status line says that the card's Stop Turn ends the turn, so it is the only one, and Alt+Ctrl+. stops nothing. The turn ends with 'You stopped this turn after 29 s · 12 tool calls ran' and Continue, which starts a new turn in the same conversation: no red diagnostic, no '[Request interrupted by user]' as the person's message, no error state, and the terminal reads 'Chat · Claude Code in fix-nav · stopped by you · 29 s' (FAIL-5, WORD-4, WORD-7, CC-24, Backend 10; chat-compose-2-03). The draft stays and Send keeps its own place, so a second press cannot send it (KEY-11). A message the agent never read ends 'Not read: you stopped the turn first' (STATE-1). This step's undo is local: Continue (UNDO-4).

sources.label: Replaces: interrupt result sets status error
Replaces: stop marks the reply incomplete
Replaces: Send takes Stop's place

nodes.label: Changed 2 files
nodes.explanation: Compact chat shows the reply to the person's latest message and the turn's receipt, built from the journal's edit events with no Git command (O22, UNDO-5, [discuss] Backend 11). Live: 'Changed 2 files: src/header.tsx, src/nav.css · not committed' with Copy Reverse Patch and Ask to Undo, which puts an undo request into the composer, unsent, and 'Claude Code also ran 2 commands; files they wrote are not listed' (O19). Worktree: 'Committed on fix-nav-header in ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav-header · not merged' with Switch and Restart Stack (O1, SURF-15). Make tickets: the agent's tickets or drafts and 'Changed no files' (O11, O21). The receipt is the turn's one outcome; while chat is closed, Chat carries it as 'reply ready' with no activity line (FB-2; proposed exception to FB-1). It is announced once, 'Claude Code replied: The header now uses NavLink. Changed 2 files.' (FB-9), and the terminal and log print one line, 'Chat · Claude Code (Haiku 4.5) in fix-nav · replied · changed 2 files · 29 s' (FB-10, Backend 15; chat-conversations-05). There is no Undo: devhost names the way back (UNDO-5).

sources.label: Replaces: latest reply, whichever turn
Replaces: every line names a 32-hex session
Replaces: one line per delivery step

nodes.label: Conversation list
nodes.explanation: The conversation list opens from chat's header as a popover anchored to its control (SURF-2, MENU-1): every conversation of the stack, this page's checkout first, then by last activity, each row 'Fix the nav header · Claude Code · Haiku 4.5 · fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav · 14:02 · waiting for you', the ID behind Copy ID, and a filter once it overflows (SEL-8, SEL-4, SEL-10, WORD-6; chat-conversations-01). Close Conversation never asks: it ends the agent's process and turn, keeps the transcript read-only in the list and leaves 'Closed by you · 14:10'; Resume continues the same conversation with its history and title in its own checkout (REV-1, UNDO-4, CC-38, Backend 8; chat-conversations-02). A close that fails says so where it was pressed, 'Could not close Fix the nav header: devhost did not answer. Its agent may still be running.', with Copy Error and Close Conversation still available (FAIL-2; chat-conversations-09). New Conversation heads the list; row actions are Tab stops named with their target (KEY-10, KEY-6). This step's undo is local: Resume (UNDO-4).

sources.label: Replaces: agent and a 32-hex ID as the label
Replaces: list in map order, unsorted
Replaces: close clears the transcript at once

nodes.label: Another checkout's chat
nodes.explanation: After a worktree switch, or Switch and Restart Stack from a worktree receipt, a conversation of another checkout of the stack stays listed under its checkout label with its transcript, its decision cards and Stop Turn: its approvals stay answerable and its turn stoppable from this page, and Chat and the collapsed badge keep their waiting look (SEL-5, SEL-8, CC-38, Backend 6; chat-checkout-switch-01). It takes no message from this page, because send goes only into the page's checkout: in place of Send the composer reads 'Fix the nav header runs in main ~/acme; this page runs fix-nav ~/acme/.worktrees/fix-nav.' with New Conversation in this checkout, the draft kept; devhost never moves a conversation, and Return to Configured Checkout lets it take messages again (UNDO-5). The agent, model, mode, open state and draft stay through the switch, kept per stack (SEL-11, CC-9; chat-checkout-switch-03). worktree-switch's reach line names working and waiting conversations before a switch (chat-checkout-switch-02), and its outcome names those left behind (FB-4).

sources.label: Replaces: chat root follows the page's checkout
Replaces: chat settings keyed by checkout path

nodes.label: Agent exited mid-reply
nodes.explanation: When the agent's CLI exits during a turn, the cut-off reply ends with its cause and what was kept, 'Claude Code exited with code 1 at 14:02 before finishing this reply. The conversation is kept up to here.', never as a finished reply (FAIL-3, WORD-8; chat-compose-2-04). The header reads 'closed · Claude Code exited'; Resume leads, Copy Error holds the CLI's last diagnostic lines, and the recipient line says 'Send resumes this conversation' (MENU-5, FAIL-2, UNDO-4). The server publishes the exit code, or the signal by name with its status, its time and the last diagnostic lines it already keeps as the conversation's closed cause (Backend 10, CC-24). On macOS an idle Claude Code conversation that a stop ends reads 'closed · Acme Shop stopped', never a failed process, because an EPERM from killpg on an exited, unreaped group counts as stopped (chat-conversations-03). The failure stays until it is dismissed or the conversation resumes, through a reconnect and a reload (FB-6).

sources.label: Replaces: exit sets status error
Replaces: footer shows only agent and status
Replaces: EPERM on an exited group is a failure

nodes.label: Connection lost
nodes.explanation: When the chat socket drops while the stack runs, the page reconnects with back-off; meanwhile Send, every answer and Stop Turn are unavailable with 'Lost connection to this conversation; reconnecting', said once in the composer's status line with Retry Now and given to each blocked control as its accessible description (HOLD-1, HOLD-5, MENU-3; chat-compose-2-05). Sends in flight settle as Delivery unconfirmed and are never resent (REV-12); the draft, images and page context stay (UNDO-2); reconnecting replays the history and any pending request, and 'Connected again' is announced once (ACT-5, FB-9). 'Reconnect before sending.' is gone. When the page loses its status stream, every chat write takes the page's one reason, 'Lost connection to devhost; retrying' unless the stream named its cause, and conversations stay listed with 'last seen 16:24', never drawn as closed or failed (HOLD-2, STATE-3); notices-and-feedback owns that notice. Service operations block nothing in chat (HOLD-3).

sources.label: Replaces: 'Reconnect before sending.' error

nodes.label: Chat off or no agent
nodes.explanation: With [devtools.chat] enabled = false, conversations already running keep running: a notice names each, 'Chat is off: Fix the nav header is still working', Chat stays on the bar while one runs, and its approvals stay answerable and its turn stoppable until it ends (HOLD-5, CC-18, CC-38, Backend 7; chat-approvals-08). Send is unavailable with 'Chat is off in devhost.toml ([devtools.chat] enabled = false); running conversations stay reachable until they end', and the draft stays; new conversations wait until chat is on again. With no agent CLI installed, Send reads 'No coding agent found: devhost looks for codex and claude on your PATH. Install one, then press Refresh Agents.', with Refresh Agents beside it (MENU-3, HOLD-1). A deleted page checkout makes Send unavailable with the repository's one blocked sentence, led by Return to Configured Checkout (HOLD-4, MENU-5); a rejected manifest blocks nothing (HOLD-6).

sources.label: Replaces: chat off answers 404 on every route

nodes.label: Ended by a stack stop
nodes.explanation: devhost stop ends every conversation of the stack without waiting for a turn, and its output names the conversations it ended (FB-4, REV-7; stack-run-stop owns the command's words and the rest of chat-conversations-03). An open page keeps every conversation listed as 'closed · Acme Shop stopped at 16:24 by devhost stop'; Send, every answer and Stop Turn are unavailable with the one reason the status stream sent, 'Acme Shop stopped. Start it with devhost start in ~/acme', in the composer's status line and as each control's accessible description, and the draft stays (HOLD-1, HOLD-2, ACT-10). When the stack runs again, the page reconnects, says 'Connected again' once, and lists the ended conversations as closed with their cause and Resume, from the record O23 keeps without message text; resuming one continues the CLI's own saved conversation ([discuss] Backend 9, UNDO-4, CC-38; chat-conversations-03). devhost stop --worktrees and devhost stack restart --all ask, or refuse without a terminal or under AGENT=1, only while a turn works or waits (REV-7, O33).

sources.label: Replaces: stop closes every session and journal
Replaces: a missing saved conversation dropped

cards.title: What changes versus today
items: Removed: the worktree-and-merge prompt appended out of sight (CC-10); the Chat Settings dialog and its Conversation picker; the second + icon; Escape stopping a turn; Stop Generating; 'Denied by the user.'; a stop shown as an error; raw JSON above the answers; random 32-character conversation labels; 13 terminal lines per turn; discovery on every toolbar load; Close emptying the panel; 'Reconnect before sending.' with no way to reconnect; raw server text as an error

Merged: the Conversation picker and Close Conversation into one conversation list with New Conversation and Resume; Stop Generating, Escape and the card's Stop Turn into one Stop Turn on Alt+Ctrl+.; the spinner, the notice, the collapsed badge and the running agents trigger into one waiting state that leads to one decision card

New: the edit mode with the checkout label and 'Added by devhost' (O1); the recipient line, the agent and model chip and the approval line; a mode line on every sent message; devhost's records in the journal (CC-40); the pinned decision card with the diff or command, a Deny note and answer lines; the turn's receipt with its way back (O22); conversations across checkouts, kept after a stop; Continue, Take Back, Alt+Ctrl+C; image sizes; the draft record; AGENT=1; a guarded, cached catalog

Changed: Escape never stops a turn (CC-29); storage per stack and page origin (CC-9); the second-agent question only in live mode, Cancel focused (CC-14); every conversation of the stack listed, send only into the page's checkout (CC-38); Close keeps the conversation; chat off keeps running ones reachable (CC-18); Chat Settings is a popover; Deny carries a note (CC-16); prompt follows each mode's instructions (O35); Harness becomes Agent (CC-31); the Disable Reloads request starts a new conversation (O27)

Kept: conversations belong to the stack and survive reloads; devhost never answers or pre-approves; Delivery unconfirmed and no resend; a cancelled send returns its draft; the second-agent question; activity lines never hold message text; [devtools.chat] applies through hot reload; the page never names a directory; the control guard, the 64 KiB body, the 8 MiB frame and 16 queued sends; the CLI's own sign-in and settings; no Git command; SIGTERM then SIGKILL after 2 s; idle shutdown waits for a working or waiting agent; chat inside the page's modal dialog

cards.title: Evidence
items: Designed against alexgorbatchev/devhost at edb5c0fc01cabae490e92ac23d4c785ec896c4ed and the shared UX pattern reference revision 3
Drawn from the current diagram and the written proposal; sources cite only existing code a step reuses or replaces at that revision, and steps with no code yet have none
